title: General Defender / offline Arc demo report-query parameters

operation.description: report exports the complete fixed scope; query returns filtered structured evidence.

resource_group.description: Case-insensitive exact resource-group match, evaluated locally.

server_name.description: Case-insensitive resource-name substring, evaluated locally; not KQL or a URL. The legacy parameter name is retained.

mde.description: Installation and sensor health are distinct. healthy requires independent sensor evidence.

limit.description: Requested query page size. The 3500-byte serialized transport budget can return fewer rows; responses disclose total_matched, returned, has_more and transport_capped.

offset.description: Query page offset. A later tool call collects a new snapshot, not a stored cursor.

risk.description: Native Defender risk.level / observed path risk, never metadata.severity.

association.description: For attack_paths/software: all context, exact Arc-related rows or other subscription resources.

resource_type.description: Exact case-insensitive provider/type or native assessed kind, e.g. Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults or sqlOnMachineDatabase. Fixed local filter, not arbitrary KQL.
